svg.aria-label: Five panels, 1 per collective, each showing 4 ranks before and after. Broadcast: only rank 0 holds 1 0 2 1, and afterwards every rank holds it. Reduce: the ranks hold 1 0 2 1, 2 1 0 3, 0 3 1 0 and 1 2 4 1, and afterwards rank 0 holds their sum 4 6 7 5. All-reduce: every rank holds 4 6 7 5. Reduce-scatter: rank r keeps element r of the sum, 4, 6, 7 and 5. All-gather: each rank starts with 1 piece and ends with all 4, 4 6 7 5.
svg.text: 4 ranks, 4 numbers each: what every rank holds before and after.
rank r keeps piece r of the sum
The sum of the 4 inputs is 4, 6, 7, 5.
